svg.title: Lasutriv — personnel file
svg.desc: Codename Lasutriv. Role: game developer working with autonomous AI agents. Latest ops: Monarchy and New Roots. Field asset: AIA-Evolve, an AI agent that ships code around the clock. Studio: Summit Tec. Status: declassified.
